2. NEW THEOREM FW.1: ALL 84 GENERIC JACOBIANS HAVE A NONZERO Q-RATIONAL POINT OF EXACT ORDER THREE

 I=12AE−3BD+C²,
 J=72ACE+9BCD−27AD²−27B²E−2C³.

 E_{a,b,j}: v²=w³−27 I w−27 J.
Let n=a²+b². EXACT SYMBOLIC 84-CASE ENUMERATION partitions the full label list into ONLY THREE (I,J) polynomial pairs, multiplicities 36,36,12. For each pair, the rational point with w0=12n² and the indicated rational nonzero v0 below lies on E and has exact order3.

4. NEW THEOREM FW.2: ORIGINAL PHYSICAL UNIFORM HEIGHT/COUNT, NOT JUST EXCEPTIONAL SUPPORT

Otherwise choose ONE actual physical rational point (y0,z0) on C as origin, of rational coordinate heights bounded B^{A0}: p≤B^(1/3), a,b polynomial p, |X|,|Y| rational heights<=B, and Z polynomial in their bounded-height coordinates, with finite fixed-degree formulas. For every other physical point, use the fully explicit FV quartic-to-Weierstrass uniform basepoint map:
 write f(y0+s)=z0²+f1s+f2s²+f3s³+f4s⁴.
 If z0 !=0, set x=(2z0(Z+z0)+f1s)/s², A=x²−4z0²f4, Bstar=−2f1x−4z0²f3, eta=(2As+Bstar)/(4z0).
 Then eta²=x³+f2x²+(f1f3−4z0²f4)x+z0²f3²+f1²f4−4z0²f2f4.
 If z0=0, set x=1/s, eta=Z/s² and scale X=f1*x, T=f1*eta; then T²=X³+f2X²+(f1f3)X+f1²f4.
 Both are exact birational models for genus-one C with physical-origin choice; coefficient heights and physical image heights are ≤ B^{A1} for some absolute fixed A1 UNIFORM in p and j since all formulas have fixed degree and input numerator/denominator heights B^{O(1)}. Marta Dujella, Uniform bounds for the number of rational points of bounded height on certain elliptic curves, Acta Arith. 217 (2025), 309–332, Theorem 1.1 and Cor.1.3 (https://arxiv.org/html/2312.03655), applies for E/Q having ANY rational point of exact prime order ell, notably ell=3. Count genuine original positive primitive P=(e,x,y,U,V,z,R) obeying U^2=e^2+x^2, V^2=e^2+y^2, z^2=x^2+y^2, R^2=e^2+x^2+y^2; R=pqr<=B with p<q<r three distinct split primes p,q,r congruent1 mod4. Sixteen FJ discriminant-degree-two placements have an exact norm lift:
  Z^2=Q_{p,j}(Y), W^2=1+Y^2, j in J_16,
where Q_{p,j} is rational quadratic with nonzero discriminant and Res_Y(Q,1+Y^2)!=0 for each physically admissible p; its coefficients are rational functions of a=u^2-v^2,b=2uv,p=u^2+v^2 of FIXED degrees with no pole at admissible p. 2. NEW EXACT UNIFORM QUOTIENT FV.1
For each j and p, set V=ZW. The smooth genus-one curve C_{p,j}: Z^2=Q(Y), W^2=1+Y^2 maps by degree2 to
  D_{p,j}: V^2=f(Y):=(1+Y^2) Q(Y).

Their pair partition defines a NONZERO Q-rational 2-torsion point on Jac(D), uniformly in all admissible p. The involution (Z,W)->(-Z,-W) is the degree2 deck transformation over D; no same-P source counting is lost because only an upper bound with finite (at most 2) fibers is sought.
If D has no rational point from a genuine source, the original packet is empty. Otherwise fix one actual physical D point P0=(y0,v0) as origin (not a hypothetical low-height rational point). Then E=(D,P0) is an elliptic curve over Q with rational exact 2-torsion and the original physical population injects into a universally bounded union of E(Q) points.


3. NEW EXPLICIT COEFFICIENT/ORIGIN HEIGHT ADAPTER FV.2
All source coordinates p,a,b,X,Y,Z,W,V and the quartic f coefficients have multiplicative rational height <= B^{A0} for an absolute fixed A0; this follows from the FJ fixed-degree rational formulas, p<=B^(1/3), H(X),H(Y)<=B, and clearing the quadratic discriminant and norm squares (rational numerators/denominators of bounded-degree polynomial values), with denominators nonzero for admissible p.  A*s^2+Bstar*s+(f1^2-4*v0^2*(f2+x))=0
and its discriminant divided by 16*v0^2 is
  eta^2=x^3+f2*x^2+(f1*f3-4*v0^2*f4)*x
            +v0^2*f3^2+f1^2*f4-4*v0^2*f2*f4.
The cubic is nonsingular because D is smooth and these formulas give a birational equivalence (away from finite exceptional denominators). Explicit inverse s=(4*v0*eta-Bstar)/(2*A) when A!=0, and then V recovered by the displayed expression. At most a bounded number of exceptional points (s=0, A=0) need separate counting. This is a monic rational Weierstrass model with rational coefficients of height B^{O(1)}; clearing denominators via a rational square/cube scaling yields an integral model of coefficient height B^{O(1)}. Heights of (x,eta) for source points likewise B^{O(1)}.


CASE v0=0. Then f(y0)=0 and f1!=0 since f squarefree. For s!=0 define x=1/s, eta=V/s^2 and obtain
  eta^2=f1*x^3+f2*x^2+f3*x+f4.
With X=f1*x, T=f1*eta, one has
  T^2=X^3+f2*X^2+(f1*f3)*X+f1^2*f4.
Again birational outside one bounded exceptional set; rational coefficient and source point heights B^{O(1)}, and scaling yields a suitable integral Weierstrass model.
These two explicit cases remove the unquantified Abel-Jacobi-model/unknown-origin issue present in the other245 unaudited FS families. All statements are absolute UNIFORM in moving p and the finite list of16 j; no rank or Lang conjecture is required.

Dujella (Acta Arithmetica 217 (2025), 309–332), uniform rational bounded-height point theorem on elliptic curves having Q-rational nonzero 2-torsion, applies with an absolute sufficiently large H0=B^A because the integral Weierstrass coefficient height and every physical image height are polynomial in B. For some absolute C, every admissible p,j has
 #{original positive primitive P with R=pqr<=B, fixed least p, class j in J16}
    <= exp(C*log B/loglog B) = B^{o(1)}.

 N_16(B;P) <= const*P*exp(C*log B/loglog B).
For any fixed delta>0, N_16(B;B^(1/3-delta))=B^(1/3-delta+o(1)).

The count is for genuine physical same-P candidates; finite Gaussian lift multiplicity is bounded, and filters only reduce it. Let J_84 be the 84 labeled FJ macro allocations whose discriminant-X odd squarefree Y-branch quartic is irreducible over Q(t), with t=v/u for a primitive split prime p=u²+v², a=u²-v²,b=2uv, p≡1 (mod4), u,v coprime opposite parity.
